notes: These are the RNA-seq arm of a ribosome-profiling study (Li et al. 2018 protocol; shared extract protocol describes MNase digestion and gel size selection); per settled rule the mRNA-seq arm of a ribosome-profiling protocol is excluded -> assay_class other. Chemostat C/N/P/Leu limitation -> nutrient_limited_growth, adapted, phase not_applicable, aerobic (aeration 4.5 l/h). Batch WT in glucose MOPS minimal and defined rich MOPS are untreated -> controls; WT chemostat samples set is_control false (treated). Unsure: whether WT chemostat samples should be controls too. Batch culture phase not given (growth rate only), left out; shaking not stated.

assay_class.q: The RNA was separated using hot phenol and size selected on 15% TBE-Urea PAGE gels run for 1 hour at 210V.
